name: hud_cheat_execute_command_string
description: HudCheat::ExecuteCommandString matches localized cheat command substrings, dispatches pickup effects, restores inactive local-player respawn state, and binds hotkey callbacks.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred until the surrounding HudCheat command/state cluster is verified.
The native smoke patches accepted direct callees so the command parser branches and state mutations can be isolated from full gameplay runtime side effects.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x406af0 checks the MFC CString length, calls CString::GetBuffer(1), compares against zLoc messages 0x1000, 0x1001, 0x1002, 0x1005, and 0x1004 with zStr::ContainsCaseInsensitive, returns Pickup::ApplyEffect for pickup ids 0x385, 0x386, and 0x387, and binds commands 0x1f and 0x24 to HudUi::HandleHotkeyCommand without changing the return value.

The respawn branch clears recent-hit light state, restores inactive local-player lifecycle to local, applies previous steering and camera state, recenters mouse control, invokes the destroyed respawn effect action, resets damage state, zeros transient mode input fields, transitions through track and mode-specific master-type helpers, gates the primary gun at g_Time_AccumulatedTimeSec, sets altGunTransitionState to 16, and then applies pickup id 0x386.

The native smoke validates empty-string early return, pickup command dispatch for ids 901 and 903, dual hotkey binding for commands 31 and 36, no-match fallthrough, and the inactive sub-mode respawn state-reset path with accepted direct callees patched to record calls.
